## AI-Generated Fix (python)

```python
from flask import Flask, render_template_string, request

app = Flask(__name__)

@app.route('/', methods=['GET', 'POST'])
def index():
    user_input = request.form.get('user_input', '')
    # Fix: Use a safe rendering method instead of render_template_string
    # return render_template_string(user_input)
    return render_template('safe_template.html', user_input=user_input)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    app.run(host='0.0.0.0', port=8882)
```

---

## Explanation

The vulnerability was caused by using render_template_string with user input, which allowed for arbitrary code execution. The fix involves using a pre-defined template file (safe_template.html) with render_template, which safely handles user input without executing it as code.
